[i]
The clicking of shoes echoed through the hallway as Delling Rembran followed behind Sarius Zenelli. Sarius Zenelli, despite his opposition to Delling's decision to try to play both sides, still had responsibilities to the company, including presenting Miosul Styx Corporation's own mobile suits to throw into the fray in the coming war.

[pre]"And to start this tour... is the most basic of our units. The first units of Miosul Styx's General Mobilization Suit line."[/pre]

Sarius gestured to his right, showing one of the first mobile suits in the company's line of production, fitted for combat, a simple mass-production model, created initially for basic security in the Styx colony, now modified for more... prolonged, and heavier space engagements.

[pre]"The M/GMS-2B Modified, as the name suggests, is a modified version of our M/MS-2A mobile suits used for security here in the Miosul Styx Colony, but the GMS-2B, however, has been upgraded, and outfitted with a more... appropriate beam rifle for more lethality, now also equipped with detacthable beam sabers mounted on each side of it's backpack for close combat, and also where it also stores additional ammunition. Its shield has also been modified to have four rapid-fire beam guns for combat."[/pre]

The corporate presentation continues, Delling Rembran's eyes inspecting the mobile suit, unimpressed, but it was to be expected; it was a mass-production model, after all. Sarius gestured for the CEO to continue following him, continuing to present more of the available mobile suits ready for production, as Sarius moved and gestured to the next window.

[pre]"And over here... is the M/HGMS-10 Dilanza."[/pre]

He gestures to a bulkier, heavier mobile suit, more armored and, by extension, more armed.

[pre]"It comes equipped with a missile launcher loaded on its back holding four Anti-Mobile Missiles, a high-output beam cannon, a grenade launcher, and, if it calls for it, a beam saber for close combat. But I should point out here that the GMS-10 is not designed for close combat; it is a heavy mobile suit designed to fire heavy ordnance in a medium to long range. Whether it has to use its beam saber for such an occasion, however, it is entirely up to the pilot themselves."[/pre]

The CEO's eyes looked ahead to the next window, seeing two mobile suits. One is currently ready for presentation; the other is missing legs and an arm. Delling approached the window, his sharp blue eyes sizing up the two mobile suits. Catching the attention of Sarius, who'd move beside him to continue his presentation,

[pre]"The Mobile suit in front of you... would be the M/GMS-07B Pilen, A... mass production, close quarters combat unit. Miosul Styx's newest and most advanced mobile suit so far. Armed with five 75mm machine guns on its left fingers, a heat rod on its right forearm. A retractable rod capable of delivering high voltage shock against enemy mobile suits, a beam rifle, or a still experimental machine gun."[/pre]

Sarius explained, focusing on the mobile suit that was in front, clearly proud of his most recent accomplished work, and while it was impressive, Delling's eyes shifted to the other one not being presented, the one that didn't even have legs, the one that stood out.

[pre]"What about this one?"

"Hm? Oh, the Thorn prototype. Still a work in progress..."

"It has no classification name?"

"No, not yet. We've simply been calling it the Thorn so far."

"What does it do?"[/pre]

Sarius' gaze shifted to the GMS-07B, then back to the Thorn,

[pre]"To put things simply... It's a customized, more advanced version of the GMS-07... we're still a couple of weeks, maybe even a few months away from properly finalizing it, but when we do... put in the right hands, it'll do wonders."[/pre]
[/i]

[quote=-chimor;59156458]Life cycle of the Bloxori(Water Bloxori).
[b] Fragment[/b] Up to 2 months.
Upon division, the newborn Bloxori are minuscule beings with about 5 centimeters at max and 5-10 grams of weight, they can not move by themselves instead being dragged by the sea currents, early food vacuoles are responsible for their food, as the water enter, their contractile vacuole filter the excessive water and bring nutrients to where it should be.
The mortality rate on this phase is big, as most Fragments get eaten by fish at this phase, their nucleus need much nutrients and water to expand itself and develop organelles, at this phase, the Bloxori are translucid, so much they are almost invisible to others, making hard their detection and therefore "saving".
[b]Formative[/b]( From 3-6 months)
On this phase, the Bloxori will begin to develope Organelles, and the structure of the reproductive nucleus begin to develop, despite slow, they can swim against the current if weak or not too strong, they also begin to have a thicker layer to protect their cytoplasm, organelles and nucleus.
The formative period makes the Bloxori quite quickly expand their size, to around 30 CM max and 250 Grams.
Note: Bloxori colonies, made up of around 50-2500 of them, created next to sea currents to capture baby Bloxori so ensure they will not die on open sea, and bring them to nurseries on coral reefs, where they can grow, develop  and create better connection symbiosis with bacterias.
[b]Explorer phase[/b] Between 6 months - 2 years.
During this phase, the  young Bloxori pseudopods develop greatly, and they can move faster than ever, moving farther from the colonies to explore the seas, and even potentially land, thought rare, they also tend to try hunting in groups, usually their preys are smaller planktons or fish.
During this phase their reproduction nucleus stop developing until get older.
This phase is not only  exploring seas, as this phase seems taht Bloxori also will develop communication and will be integrated better into colonies as they learn more about communicating and living in colonies.
They not grow much on this phase compared to previous, and can have about 50cm or 70cm and 600Grams of weight, however their mobility is something to be admired.
[b]Ascending/Adolescent[/b]: 2 years -6 years.
A phase of great development, the Ascending phase is where the reproductive nucleus of Bloxori is fully functional, and ocasionally, if requirements such as great mass and size, and abundance of resources, a little part of their reproductive nucleus expell small part of it outside the body and ....then taht is how a Bloxori is born.
Their bodies begin to gain shape and colour, which varies from, shades of blue, green and even orange, tho the last is rarer, also their skin begins to become more crystaline, and even bioluminescent.
Their communication is at peak, their reproduction can make up around 3 Bloxori surge during this phase, while their Nucleus begins to develope better the feelings thought.
They grow much more during this phase, and can reach 1 meter and 4 Kg
[b]Juvenile/Crystaline[/b]. 6 years-12 years.
This phase is marked by intense appearance changes and mass increase, this phase they can grow up to 1,20 M, largest individuals tho have about 1,50M, while weight increases due their silicate skeleton expansion, their appearance reach at it peak, as "peak of Bloxori beauty standards", their reproduction reach at it highest point, with over dozens of fragments can be produced by a single juvenile Bloxori.
Their regeneration rate is at it peak, their health, everything, the healthiest and best phase of the Bloxori, their mass at this point can reach 10-15Kg.
[b]Adulthood[/b]. 12-25 years
The longest phase of Aquatic Bloxori, their reproduction slowly decrease, but not much, those who take care of Forming Bloxori, teaching, and administering colonies are in their adulthood, hunters and gatherers are from this phase, leading expeditions to outer colonies to expand, and bring food.
Their size and weight begins to decrease slowly after this period, their size varies between 1,10-1m while weight decrease to 6KG.
[b]Elder[/b], +25.
The most venerable stage of a aquatic bloxorior, at elder phase their bodies slowly begin to fail, as their retractile vacuoles begin to fail filtrating water, making "bloats" more common, their regeneration rate is really slow, any wound on their bodies can cause potential death, and they are infertile, at this age, they exile themselves from colonies to die in peace, is unknown, but most Bloxorior die around their 30s, due their exile is unknown how much they can actually live, as when they "desintegrate" barely anything rest from their bodies.
Their size and weight are irrelevant, as they slowly die, it also does slowly reduces, as their nucleus and organelles begin to fail...
[b]Land Life cycles[/b].
In general, life cycles of Land Bloxorior are...slower, such as the Fragment, which happens when a piece of a Bloxorior leave a fragment of itself on a tree in a "gelatinous mass" on trees, this cycle lasts around 2 years, as they slowly grow, the explorer phase never happens, Juvenile phase happens between 2-15 years, while their "Juvenile phase" lasts between 15-40 years, their silicate skeleton is also present, tho the reproduction rate is a bit slower, with a average of 8 fragments per Bloxorior.
At Adulthood, which lasts around 40-80 years, they take groups to migrate between caves and lead expeditions with their communities and groups, while +80 is old age, while they are also infertile, do not exile themselves, instead take more "leadership" positions.
The juvenile Bloxori are the most commonly used for medicine as they have larger regeneration rate.[/quote]

"Ms. El Howayek, you have to check this out."

"Mmm?..." Euphrasia sounded out, looking behind her to see a staffer holding what seems to be a rather dense file folder. You could smell the freshness of the printer ink, never mind the warmth of the paper as Euphrasia took it into her hands. "What's this?"

"A compilation of reports courtesy of International Policy. ISCOS is defying the Federation on the Dupont issue."

"I don't need this right now" Euphrasia says, sighing as she turned the page of the file folder. "We're currently sitting on a powder keg that's just waiting for a tinderbox called Korrin to blow everything up. Who cares if a competitor is taking what isn't theirs?"

"The Federation deems it a great threat, Ms. El Howayek." the staffer says calmly.

"What does SummitONE think?"

"They think ISCOS is being hampered from conducting its business."

"Of course they do... man... am I really being called into this?..." Euphrasia scrunched up her face, clearly annoyed by this rapidly devolving series of events. A rebellion, reports of massacres in deep space, and now a disobedient Erenite megacorporation taking over Federation territory. For a moment, El Howayek pondered whether the Federation truly was worth saving after all. But she held the thought in private. "Agh, this is ridiculous... someone get someone to contact Governor Daza, I'll see what I can do in the mean time! Just don't bother me right now any more, if there's something urgent, get Euphemia to sort things out, she's always on her ass anyways."

"Very well, Ms. El Howayek. Shall I inform Mr. FitzDavid of what's been discussed right now?"

"God no. He'll try and delay things until this becomes a [i]fait accompli[/i]. The last thing we need right now is more distractions. Now go, shoo, shoo. I'll be busy trying to save this piece of crap Federation from falling apart..."

- - -

[b]Operation Crusader[/b]

The League of the Orange Creek was now in crisis mode. SummitONE, the [i]de facto[/i] monopoly on much of the nation's military assets, was currently busy "with highly academic matters" and was unwilling to send any assets to protect the Federation from her enemies. Thus, the fate of Erene rested, in part, on the El Howayek Group (EHG), a predominantly civilian conglomerate under the control of the El Howayek Sisters. Though well-regarded for their inventory of spacecraft designs, EHG was behind on most emerging military tech, namely concerning the use of mobile suits.

Still though, as the League's most pro-Federation corporate body, the EHG had to do something if it means preserving the fragile political order that had helped sustain the League for decades up to this point. Not that Euphrasia El Howayek, EHG CEO, would be particularly enthusiastic about this newfound duty.

After a brief session with Emperor Candor II Daza, the incumbent Vespurian Emperor and Governor of the League, EHG would be authorized to execute a punitive expedition on behalf of the Federation to punish what it deems "to be the harbingers of violence and disorder", organizing a fleet of 6 Andiron-class gunboats and 2 Speedwell-class escort frigates to attempt and dismantle the ISCOS Dupont colony. Supreme command over the operation would be given to Daza himself, a distinguished veteran of the recent Marisalbic War.

However, despite the heavy firepower being spent by the League for this expedition, in reality, the EHG would not be willing to initiate as the aggressor.

An hour before Operation Crusader was due to begin, the EHG would send a civilian shuttle to the ISCOS Dupont project, firing infrared communication lasers at its satellites to initiate contact. In a brief set of demands, the EHG would ask ISCOS to negotiate the dismantlement of its colonial project in return for several assurances which the EHG and the wider League hopes to uphold with the Federation High Council. These points would be summarized as follows:

[list]1. ISCOS is to cancel the development of its ISCOS colony and return to Erene within the earliest possible time frame.

2. ISCOS is to exhaust all policy mechanisms to peacefully reintegrate under the Erene Federation's constitutional framework.

And in exchange,

3. The League promises a waiting period of 1 year, during which it shall attempt to lobby the adoption of a legal remedy to enable ISCOS to legally settle Dupont and achieve its territorial ambitions.

4. The League promises to come to ISCOS's aid in any future war against an enemy that seeks to undermine its geopolitical interests.[/list]

If the above measures are not honored, or if ISCOS is unwilling to discuss a revision of the terms within a 1 week grace period, Emperor Candor II shall be formally empowered as an officer of the Federation to begin its punitive expedition to remove ISCOS by an awesome feat of force and arms.

[b]Erene Federation Emergency Resolution: January 14th, 2167.[/b]

[b]Briefing:[/b]

[i]More and more of our colonies have broken away from the Erene Federation, utterly crushing our economies which rely heavily on resources from beyond the Belt of Tears. However, these breakaways cannot produce their own food in sufficient quantities to sustain their populations. The Erene Federation fears that a war between Erene and the Spacenoid breakaways will result in heavy casualties and destruction of large sections of Erene. As such, the Federation believes that any methods need to be taken to minimise losses for Federation forces and civilians.[/i]

[i]The Erene Federation has a monopoly on food, and the colonies relied on our exports to sustain their populations. The High Council advises that all member states of the Erene Federation to cease all food trade beyond the Belt of Tears, no ship carrying food or any trade goods shall be legally permitted to travel beyond the Belt of Tears. The High Council believes this decision will force the breakaways to peacefully return into Federation control, returning to the status quo.[/i]
